memory_candidates.content: When an implement-phase dispatch edits a script under a source-store extension (e.g. agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/*.sh) and that phase's own verification criterion includes doc-lint (verify-deploy.sh gate 3 / check-extension-docs.sh), expect a hard FAIL on 'deployed script content drift (deployed != extension source)' until the source store is redeployed -- this check is an unconditional fail() in check-extension-docs.sh, never gated by STRICT_CORE_DEPLOY (unlike the separate core-deploy ADVISORY channel for markdown/rule drift). If the plan's own redeploy phase comes later (e.g. a dedicated final 'Redeploy and Full Gate' phase), redeploy early (ahead of schedule) in the script-editing phase itself so that phase's own narrower gate can pass honestly; the later plan-scheduled redeploy is idempotent and simply reconfirms.

deploy-headless.sh exits 3 (RESULT=landed_verify_red) when the deploy itself lands successfully but its own internal fast-gate verify-deploy.sh run finds any issue -- this is NOT the same as 'the deploy failed' (exit 1/2, RESULT=not_landed). Before treating a non-zero deploy-headless.sh exit as a blocker, read the RESULT= marker and the fast-gate detail: a landed_verify_red outcome whose findings all name files outside the current record's declared file_scope is a pre-existing/unrelated finding to report via issue-record.sh, not a sign the redeploy itself failed.
